student_learning_goal: I can compose and decompose a structure into its parts.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can compose and decompose a structure into its parts.
header.character_watermark: Trekker Tig the Tiger Cub in the top-right with a 3D solid basket. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: For 4 structure pictures, list the 3D parts you see.
parts.visual_layout: Four structure illustrations with a list area beside each for the named parts.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 decompose layout for geometry worksheet, B&W line art. 4 structures: tower (cube + prism + pyramid), house (rectangular prism + pyramid roof), tent (triangular prism), can (cylinder). Each with a list area for parts.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P1_DECOMP at Part 1: keywords name the structures and parts list.

parts.answer_key: Tower: cube, prism, pyramid. House: prism, pyramid. Tent: prism. Can: cylinder.

parts.student_instructions: Build (or draw) 2 structures using 3 parts each. List the parts.
parts.visual_layout: Two empty workspace boxes and a labelled parts list ready to use.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 compose layout for geometry worksheet, B&W line art. 2 empty workspace boxes labelled 'My Structure 1' and 'My Structure 2'. Parts list at top: cube, prism, pyramid, cylinder, cone.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P2_COMP at Part 2: keywords name the workspace boxes and parts list for composing.

parts.answer_key: Any valid 3-part structure with named parts.

parts.student_instructions: What 2D shapes are INSIDE one named 3D solid?
parts.visual_layout: A 3D shape illustration with arrows pointing to its component 2D faces.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 2D-inside-3D layout for geometry worksheet, B&W line art. 1 cube illustration with arrows pointing to a single square face. Below: 'I see ___ squares inside a cube.' Below: similar for cylinder ('___ circles + ___ rectangle').
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P3_INSIDE at Part 3: keywords name the 2D shapes and faces inside the 3D solid.

parts.answer_key: Cube = 6 squares. Cylinder = 2 circles + 1 rectangle (when unrolled).

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, decompose your favourite toy into 3D shapes.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 consolidation. Formative — check decompose naming.
